notes.title: NEW UPDATE!
Quality of Life Update
notes.notes:
[h3]Alright, ladies and gentlemen. The time has come! 
The fixed localization of Summer Crush is now available! [/h3]

[b]But other than that... This week's update features various quality-of-life improvements, including:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game size reduced from 8 GB to 1.5 GB ːtoolidlː
[*] Added Steam Cloud Saves! Now you can delete the game and not worry about your saves! 
[*] [b]LEGENDARY[/b] "Auto" button is now in the game! Lean back in your comfy chair and enjoy the show!
[*] Added one new achievement that you asked for so much!
[/list]
Now playable! Thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Major Issue Update
notes.notes:
A lot of English speaking players has informed me about the grammar of the English localization of Summer Crush.
They all agreed that localization has been somewhat broken. The good news is that I already had sent it for correcting by a professional translator. So, expect a patch. 

Also, the size of the game was very large. As they wrote on a well-known website, it's time to convert PNG format to JPEG so that we can achieve a much more significant reduction of package size of the VN but also make sure that the quality of the images are still top-notch. Now, thanks to my friend etcroot from this problem we got rid of. 

[b]A patch should be deployed in a few days (assuming that the translation will be fixed in time), so stay tuned.[/b]
